name: Above the Cloud: Time Bound Mansion
detailed_description:
Time Bound Mansion is a co-op action RPG for 1-4 players where players create their own class.

Solo or co-op with up to three friends, step into Cloudshore Mansion, an ancient estate bound by a time spell of unknown origin. Former house of the eccentric High Theologian, Alcofrebas Nazeer - the mansion holds opportunities for adventurers willing to brave its dangers, especially those with the advantage of immortality.

Discover spells, equipment, legendary weapons, and ancient relics to forge your class fantasy. Collect and combine them to create a customized character and gain the power to face the mansion’s denizens.

Time-Bound Mansion is a theory crafter's dream! Mix and match gear and abilities for hundreds of unique builds.

Survive the cursed mansion

Assist the Archivist as he attempts to piece together the events that led to the curse of the Cloudshore mansion. Step into the nightmare of the Time-Bound and defeat its denizen to progress and uncover the fate of the estate.

Timed Trials and Endless Exploration

Rush against the clock to complete each zone before the dream collapses. Extract relics and acquire new powers.

When you feel more powerful, the archivist can send you to the mansion's hardest timelines, where you'll find better relics and valuable information on the curse's origin.

Multiple Schools to create your rotation

Mix and match abilities from the schools of shadow fire, violence, cold, nature and more to create a unique rotation with strong synergies.

The Solace Diary - Entry 001

"Some years ago, an unexplained phenomenon took place in the city of Rho'Thanika, at the Cloudsview Mansion, estate of the esteemed High Theologian of the Rho Empire - Alcofrebas Nazeer.

The exact time of the incident is unknown, but in the early hours of the morning of Climb Remembrance Day, an attendant employed by the Nazeer estate reported being unable to establish contact with the mansion staff. The service door which was usually open for the early morning deliveries was still shut hours past the usual schedule.

In addition, the attendant reported the main gate being closed shut and a strange glow emanating from the keyhole, as well as from several of the visible windows around the mansion.

On the day of the incident, it was estimated that 113 people were inside Cloudsview Mansion.

Among them: 87 staff members—attendants, kitchen staff, gardeners, stable hands, theologians, and security personnel.

Alongside them were 23 visiting civilians, including representatives of the Explorer’s Guild, the Commerce Exchange Union, Deep Mountain Mining Co., petitioners seeking the counsel of Alcofrebas, and a handful of noble guests.

And then, of course, there was Alcofrebas Nazeer himself, alongside his daughter, Alice Nazeer.

But there was one person...one soul I didn’t expect to be there: my brother.

To this day, I still don’t know why.
